title: AlloyDB Autoscaling Adds Connection Count Metric
summary: AlloyDB's autoscaling policies for read pools can now leverage connection count as a scaling metric. This allows for more granular control, enabling dynamic adjustments based on the number of active database connections.
details: The `Policy` schema for AlloyDB autoscaling now includes an optional `connectionsCount` property. This new property references the `ConnectionsCount` schema, which allows you to specify a `targetCount`. This enhancement means you can configure your read pool autoscalers to scale instances based on the desired number of database connections, alongside existing CPU utilization and schedule-based policies.
